svg.title: Manufacturing Bricks
svg.desc: Black-and-white IELTS-style process diagram showing clay digging, metal grid and roller, mixing with sand and water, shaping with wire cutter or mould, drying for 24 to 48 hours, firing at 200 to 980 and 870 to 1300 degrees Celsius, cooling for 48 to 72 hours, packaging and delivery.
svg.text: Original educational illustration for IELTS Writing Task 1 practice · Not an official test diagram
